reviews.author: Priscilla
reviews.text:
I was advised 8 sittings of CO₂ laser treatment, costing ₹44,000. Out of kindness, the dermatologist reduced it to ₹39,000 — how thoughtful! Paid ₹10,000 before the first session and, in the next visit, was asked to pay the remaining ₹29,000 “so that patients feel motivated to attend all sessions.” Very motivational indeed!

Each sitting came with new prescriptions worth ₹3,000–₹4,000 — and interestingly, the creams changed every time, even though the ones from the first session could easily last 1–2 months. If you’re going to keep changing them every sitting, maybe prescribe smaller quantities instead of large tubes?

Then came the medicine part — generic antibiotics, but charged at full MRP. When I questioned this, I was told they “do it because most patients are poor.” Touching logic! Because, as we all know, nothing says helping the poor like selling generics at branded prices.

I pointed this out politely, and from then on, let’s just say the warmth in their hospitality dropped a few degrees. I was made to wait over 2 hours before treatment during the next visit, and the assistant (the BDS doctor) had to handle it.

To be fair, the laser results were good — no complaints there. But the medicine pricing and changing prescriptions every session could definitely be more transparent and patient-friendly.

If the clinic truly wants to help poor patients, maybe they could stop charging branded prices for generic drugs and avoid wasting patients’ money on extra-large ointment tubes every week. Just a thought!

reviews.author: Salauddin Syed
reviews.text:
I recently visited Dr. Ch. Neelima Devi for a skin issue and I am extremely satisfied with her treatment. She is highly skilled, knowledgeable, and professional, making me feel comfortable and confident in her abilities from the moment I walked into her office.

During my consultation, Dr. Ch. Neelima Devi  took the time to thoroughly examine my skin and listen to my concerns. She patiently answered all my questions and explained the possible causes and treatment options in a clear and concise manner. Her expertise and attention to detail immediately put me at ease.

The treatment recommended by Dr. Ch. Neelima Devi  was effective and tailored specifically to my condition. She carefully explained the steps involved, any potential side effects, and what I should expect during the healing process. I appreciate her honesty and transparency, as it helped me manage my expectations and feel confident in the treatment plan.

Throughout the procedure, Dr. Ch. Neelima Devi  maintained a calm and gentle demeanor, ensuring my comfort and well-being at all times. Her skilled hands and precise technique minimized any discomfort, and I felt reassured knowing I was in capable hands.

After following Dr. Ch. Neelima Devi 's prescribed treatment plan, I have seen significant improvement in my skin condition. Not only did she address the initial issue, but she also provided helpful tips and guidance on how to prevent future flare-ups and maintain a healthy skin routine.

In addition to her exceptional medical skills, Dr. Ch. Neelima Devi  is also attentive and empathetic towards her patients. She genuinely cares about their well-being and takes the time to build a trusting relationship. I greatly appreciate her bedside manner and the personal attention she provides.

I would highly recommend Dr. Ch. Neelima Devi to anyone seeking dermatological care. Her expertise, professionalism, and compassionate approach make her an outstanding dermatologist. I am grateful for her excellent treatment and am confident in her ability to deliver exceptional care to all her patients.
